topic.angle: The shortest war on record: how it lasted less than an hour

panels.text: Zanzibar, August 1896. The pro-British sultan dies suddenly, and Khalid bin Barghash takes the throne without British permission.
Britain sends an ultimatum: leave the palace by 9:00 on 27 August. Khalid barricades himself inside instead.
The deadline expires at 9:00, and British ships open fire on the palace at 9:02. The flag is shot down and the firing stops, with 38 minutes being the most quoted length.
The twist: this is recorded as the shortest war in history. Around 500 of the sultan's side were killed or wounded, while just one British sailor was hurt.

probes.question: About how long is the Anglo-Zanzibar War most often said to have lasted?
True or false: the Anglo-Zanzibar War is recorded as the shortest war in history.

claims.claim: Panel 1: the pro-British sultan died in August 1896 and Khalid bin Barghash succeeded
claims.quote: the suspicious death of the pro-British Sultan Hamad bin Thuwaini on 25 August 1896 and the subsequent succession of Sultan Khalid bin Barghash
claims.note: Page says "suspicious death"; card says "dies suddenly", acceptable.

claims.claim: Panel 1: Khalid took the throne without British permission
claims.quote: a candidate for accession to the sultanate should obtain the permission of the British consul; Khalid had not fulfilled this requirement

claims.claim: Panel 2: Britain sent an ultimatum to leave the palace
claims.quote: sent an ultimatum to Khalid demanding that he order his forces to stand down and leave the palace

claims.claim: Panel 2/3: Khalid barricaded himself inside; deadline was 9:00 on 27 August
claims.quote: Khalid called up his palace guard and barricaded himself inside the palace. The ultimatum expired at 09:00 local time on 27 August

claims.claim: Panel 3: British ships opened fire on the palace at 9:02
claims.quote: A bombardment, opened at 09:02, set the palace on fire and disabled the defending artillery

claims.claim: Panel 3: the flag was shot down and firing stopped
claims.quote: The flag at the palace was shot down and fire ceased at 09:46
claims.note: Page gives 09:46 here and 09:02-09:40 in the infobox; the card only calls 38 minutes the most quoted length, which the page says too.

claims.claim: Panel 4 / probe 2: recorded as the shortest war in history
claims.quote: marking it as the shortest recorded war in history

claims.claim: Panel 4: around 500 of the sultan's side killed or wounded, one British sailor hurt
claims.quote: The sultan's forces sustained roughly 500 casualties, while only one British sailor was injured
